resources.string: 25 European languages in short utterance windows. Original captions with optional translation.
Compact recognition for English, Chinese, Cantonese, Japanese and Korean.
Parakeet recognizes 25 European languages. Selecting the source labels captions for translation; it does not force recognition. Auto may need an explicit source before translation.
SenseVoice supports English, Chinese, Cantonese, Japanese and Korean. Choose Auto or an explicit source. Arabic and Russian require another speech model.
